name: Decentralized Federated NeRF
aliases: Decentralized Neural Radiance Fields from Crowdsourced Images
definition: A decentralized framework for learning global 3D scene representations from crowd-sourced images by distributing training computation to users and aggregating only global radiance field models to minimize server compute and personal data leakage.
summary: Decentralized Federated NeRF is a privacy-preserving framework that distributes 3D scene reconstruction to users via personal and global MLP decomposition, aggregating only global models to prevent data leakage.
